The '''Crystan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> located at the very outer edge of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and not far from the planet [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]]. The space region where the Crystan system was located was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] only in the final [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], shortly after the fragmentation of the Empire, officer [[Blitzer Harrsk]] became an independent [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] and withdrew into the Deep Core, where he established his [[Zero Command|own mini-empire]]. He maintained control over the territories he had captured, including the Crystan system, at least until his death in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Crystan [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it, and therefore Crystan V, in grid square L-12.<ref name="TEA" />
